info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Account Loandetails-spec
info.description: The Account Loan Details Retrieval API allows users to access detailed loan information associated with specific customer accounts. This endpoint is essential for financial institutions and service providers looking to offer insights into individual loan products. Developers can leverage this API to enhance customer service experiences by providing timely data on loan terms, balances, and repayment schedules. Typical consumers include account managers and financial analysts tasked with assisting customers in managing their loans effectively.

get.summary: Retrieve loan details for a specific customer account.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about loans associated with a specific customer account. It provides insights into the current status, amounts, and repayment schedules of loans linked to the given account, enabling effective financial management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve loan details associated with a specific account for a customer. It includes necessary parameters and authentication tokens to process the request effectively.

200.description: Successfully retrieved loan details for the specified account.
